description:
External tracker for a spec edit being authored in a separate session against ~/PROJECT/jmap-chat-spec/draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md.

## Background

The implementation team found that draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 line 1182 places a non-member field-trim rule inside the Space/query section, but RFC 8620 §5.5 defines /query as returning only ids — field projection is a /get concern (§5.1). The previous spec text required servers to either deviate from §5.5 by adding a non-standard objects-bearing field on /query, or to silently apply the trim somewhere that no longer reads as the standard wire shape.

Decision (Mark, 2026-05-13): pick Option B from the agent triage on JMAP-v9py.4 — split the rule cleanly. Discovery stays on Space/query (which ids non-members may see); field-trim moves to Space/get (which fields non-members receive, plus the notFound classification for non-previewable spaces).

## What lands in the spec

Three edits to draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md:

1. Field definition of isPubliclyPreviewable (currently lines 723-724) — point at Space/get for the restricted-view definition instead of Space/query.
2. Space/get section (currently lines 1104-1106, one-liner) — grow a non-member-trim paragraph + a notFound rule for non-previewable spaces.
3. Space/query section (currently lines 1175-1182) — rewrite line 1182 to describe id-visibility only; remove the field-list (since trim moves to /get).

Full prompt was handed to the spec-editing session on 2026-05-13.

## Acceptance

- The spec commit lands in ~/PROJECT/jmap-chat-spec on a branch or main; Mark confirms the commit hash.
- grep verification gates from the handoff prompt pass:
  * Literal text 'Standard JMAP `/get`.' as a one-line section no longer occurs.
  * 'all other fields MUST be omitted' occurs exactly once, inside Space/get.
  * The Space/query section contains no occurrence of 'field' / 'fields' after the edit.
- File line-count delta is +20 to +25 lines (anything outside that band indicates over-editing).

## Out of scope

- The implementation bead JMAP-v9py.4 (re-targeted at handle_space_get; blocked by this bead).
- The notFound enforcement bead (filed separately under JMAP-v9py; blocked by this bead).
- Any other Space-related spec change (Space/changes, Space/set, Space/queryChanges, Space/join, Space/destroy).
title: Spec edit (external repo): move non-member field trim from Space/query to Space/get in draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00
